owner_posts.post_text: At JBCN International School Borivali, three proven entry stages help families make the right move at the right time. Children between ages 3 and 5 join before academic pressure sets in, with play-based inquiry-led learning building a natural global outlook and strong early language skills from the very start. Around Grade 6, the transition becomes about independence: students learn to question, collaborate, and apply knowledge through projects, well ahead of board exam demands. For Borivali families focused on overseas universities, Grade 9 is the strategic entry point. IGCSE followed by the IB Diploma or A Levels ensures globally recognised credentials from senior school onward. Every stage is designed for a confident, supported start. Visit JBCN Borivali and speak with our admissions team today.

Aarav Lele, part of JBCN's High Achieving Learner cohort, has secured a spot in Stanford's Discrete Mathematics course, a programme with just a 5–8% acceptance rate open to grades 8–11 worldwide.

This is what makes JBCN the best international school in Mumbai with strong academics, expert mentoring, and a proven record of high university placements that open global doors for students year after year.

Our counselling team works with every student from early on, building profiles that stand out at the world's most selective institutions. The results speak for themselves.
Your child's future starts here.

Most parents use "preschool" and "pre-primary" interchangeably, but there's a big difference.

Preschool focuses on play and basic socialisation for toddlers (ages 2–3). Pre-Primary is a structured, curriculum-driven programme (ages 3–6) that builds school-readiness through language, numeracy, cognitive skills, and emotional development.

At JBCN Borivali, our Pre-Primary programme goes beyond daycare-style learning. With an internationally benchmarked curriculum, trained educators, and a child-centred approach, we prepare your little one for confident entry into formal schooling.

JBCN Pre-Primary Borivali offers,
- Holistic Development
